access_limit: The notice does not date the onset of the broader incident or disclose root cause, customer count, log retention or alternative access paths.
The source does not independently establish every underlying claim or unreported downstream consequence.
The source does not determine legal liability or final factual truth.
The report also covers a broader 7 July ChatGPT disruption and Downdetector complaints, which cannot be merged into this FedRAMP residual-function incident.
Its FedRAMP function list repeats the OpenAI status statement and does not independently verify customer impact or audit-log loss.

occurrence_evidence.claim: On 29 June at 07:00, OpenAI said core FedRAMP functionality had returned while Codex, analytics, conversation search, custom-GPT search, invitations and the Compliance Logs download endpoint remained unavailable.
The provider said it was investigating and working to resolve the residual issues. It did not disclose the initial interruption time or individual feature restoration times.
At 02:11 on 11 July, it marked the broader incident resolved and said core functionality was restored. The final wording does not enumerate recovery of each previously named residual feature.
